But using tactics like we have never seen before.|The BX droid commando reports to Admiral Trench|}} This '''[[BX-series droid commando]]''' served on [[Anaxes]] during the [[Battle of Anaxes|battle]] between the [[Grand Army of the Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars]]. It reported to [[Admiral]] [[Trench]] on the unusual tactics employed by [[Clone Force 99]] during their infiltration of the [[Cyber Center]].
